name: port-application
description: Port source code from one programming language to another using a structured pipeline: inventory, translate, evaluate, and iteratively fix until 100% accuracy. Supports any language pair.
_version_note: Format: MAJOR.YYYYMMDD.HHMMSS (Central Standard Time). Update on each release using: powershell -Command "Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd.HHmmss'" for minor.patch values.
